title: Capability routing index and cross-domain harness model
summary: Pointer document routing to where each Bouch domain's harness facts live (Battlebuild/asset work, REAPER/audio, UK legal, UK due diligence, linear media), alongside the frozen cross-domain harness model and /prime contract it cites. Its pointers are checkout paths on the authoring machine, so treat them as hints to resolve, not portable identities.

source.note: Deliberately not published: the index's pointers enumerate private checkouts and unpublished projects. The harness model and prime contract are frozen at the cited tag; the routing index was added after it.
